items.q: How do I access the distribution portal? Do I have to register again?
items.a: To access the portal, simply go to https://dist.musicdibs.com. If you are already registered with Artist Pro or were a previous user with the annual plan, you should have received an email with a registration link. It is necessary that you also register on the distribution platform, as this is required for legal reasons. The registration link lasts 48 hours; if you missed it or didn't receive it, contact us so we can resend it.

items.q: How do royalties or commissions for my plays work?
items.a: Musicdibs does not retain any commission on your streaming royalties. Distribution is included at no extra cost with Artist Pro. Royalties are processed through our distribution infrastructure under its standard distribution terms before being reported and paid to artists.

items.q: Can I bring my songs from another distributor and save that cost?
items.a:
Yes, you can migrate songs distributed from another platform (DistroKid, CD Baby, etc.). The process is not automatic but straightforward:

1. Make sure the metadata matches exactly (title, artists, ISRC, UPC/EAN).
2. Create the release on Musicdibs using the same data and identifiers.
3. Request removal from the old distributor once accepted.
4. Verify that the platforms have updated the links.
5. There may be a brief coexistence period.

Important: Don't use new ISRCs and don't delete the original content until the new one is visible.

items.q: What happens to my songs if I cancel Artist Pro?
items.a:
REGISTRATION: All registered works will remain valid. However, you won't be able to register new works or access generated certificates.

DISTRIBUTION: Your distributed music will remain on platforms and you can accumulate more royalties, but you won't be able to distribute more songs or manage distribution. Before cancelling, you can withdraw your releases or accumulated royalties.

Important: Cancelling the plan does not automatically delete your account.

items.q: Can I get an Official Artist Channel (OAC) on YouTube with Musicdibs?
items.a:
Yes! By subscribing to the Artist Pro plan and distributing your music with us, you can request a YouTube Official Artist Channel (OAC).

Basic requirements:
• Have a channel representing only one artist or band
• Have at least one official song released on YouTube
• Comply with YouTube policies
• Have public videos and original musical content

At Musicdibs we offer an additional service for €50 to handle your OAC request directly.

items.q: What is YouTube Content ID and how can I activate it with Musicdibs?
items.a:
YouTube Content ID is the system that automatically identifies when your music is used in videos on the platform. Thanks to this system, you can monetize, track, or block any unauthorized use of your songs.

At Musicdibs, we offer Content ID activation as an additional service for €50. We handle reviewing your catalog, managing the application, and ensuring your tracks meet YouTube requirements.

items.q: Do I need an artist profile on Spotify before distributing my music?
items.a:
Yes, it's recommended. If you don't have an existing artist profile, Spotify will automatically create one — but if there's already another artist with the same name, your music could mistakenly appear on their profile.

To avoid this, create your artist profile beforehand and make sure to use exactly the same artist name when uploading through Musicdibs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about Musicdibs
faq.seo_description: Frequently asked questions about Musicdibs: blockchain registration, music distribution, certificates and more.

items.q: Are unspent subscription credits cumulative when renewed annually?
items.a: Unspent credits from annual subscriptions and special offers do not accumulate when the next billing period is renewed.

items.q: Can an underage register their productions?
items.a: Underages can request the registration of their authorship rights through their parents or legal representatives, who must prove their relationship with the minor through the appropriate document (family book or legal document that proves the guardianship or legal representation of the minor).

items.q: Can I check in Musicdibs songs that have been registered with other platforms?
items.a: No, we can only verify registrations of works made with Musicdibs. This is because we register and certify, not only the uploaded file with the content, but also the identity of the registrant. Also you should know that you can't really do this with any other property registration system, since none of them is interconnected with the rest.

items.q: Can I register musical creations on behalf of other people with my account?
items.a:
Unfortunately, registration in the name of third parties is ONLY allowed and legally recognized in the exceptional case of minors. Musicdibs' user accounts are unipersonal and non-transferable, and may belong to persons or entities (commercial, associations, etc.).

You must bear in mind that for the registration of a creation, the identity of the person or entity to whom the ownership of those rights will be granted must first be verified, and this is only possible if that same person or entity is the one that has opened the account on Musicdibs and verified it with your official identity document.

We recommend that you propose to those people that they each open a Musicdibs account with their data. It is very simple!

items.q: Can I register partial creations before registering the final one?
items.a: Yes, you can do it with Musicdibs and in fact it is recommended, to avoid someone plagiarizing you during your creation process before your work is finished. Thanks to our reduced cost, especially that of the annual subscription, you can make as many partial registrations of your work as you want, which will also allow you to share your creation with whoever you want with full guarantee that it is protected and in your name.

items.q: Can I register works that were created using AI? What does Musicdibs protect in these cases?
items.a:
Yes, you can register your works on Musicdibs even if you used AI for the musical composition, as long as:

1. You are the original author of the lyrics, the idea, or the structure of the song.
2. There was creative direction from you in the use of AI (for example, you chose the prompts, edited the result, adapted the melody, etc.).
3. The AI tool you used legally allows you to use and commercially exploit the generated results.

The registration grants you a certificate of authorship with international legal validity, backed by a timestamp and blockchain technology. This allows you to prove that you created the work on a specific date and to defend your rights in case of plagiarism or disputes.

Musicdibs does not validate or supervise AI-generated content, but it does allow you to register the final result if you were the creator or responsible party in the process. It is recommended that you indicate in the description that AI was used as a tool, and that the creative authorship is yours.

items.q: Could anyone register a work as theirs even if it has been registered before?
items.a:
Yes, but no problem! The important thing is who did it first and when (and that is just what appears in our registration certificates). Each time we register something (even if repeated) a different time stamp is generated associated with the identity of who made the certification, the certified content and the time at which it is done.

Musicdibs being a tool with validity and worldwide scope can not know if someone has already registered something before someone else in another registration system or another part of the world. But that is not what is relevant, but WHO DID IT BEFORE in a reliable way? And that is what you are guaranteed using Musicdibs.

items.q: Does registering my work in the blockchain have legal validity?
items.a: Registering your script or short video in the blockchain has legal validity in the 179 signatory countries of the Berne Convention. It is an alternative, fast and reliable way to avoid plagiarism when you share it on social networks or with your friends. It is a commitment to the future, and facilitates the process of comparing different pieces and verifying the identity of their original creator.

items.q: Does the registration of my piece have renewal costs?
items.a: No, you will only pay for the initial registration.

items.q: From what type of content can the NFTs of the subscriptions be generated?
items.a:
At the moment to generate NFTs we are accepting only audios and in the formats: mp3, wav and ogg. This is so because these are the formats supported by the Opensea marketplace, which is where we generate them and where we will send them to you (you will therefore need to have an Opensea wallet to receive them).

The possibility of also generating NFTs for videos will be opened shortly (the supported formats will be: mp4 and webm).

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: For your cancellation, you just have to go within your account profile to "settings" → "subscription" → "cancel subscription". At least 24 hours before the renewal of the new cycle.

items.q: How do monthly and annual subscriptions work?
items.a:
Both monthly and annual subscriptions are automatically renewed at the end of each contracted cycle. For example, if you sign up on November 15, the next billing cycle will be activated on December 15.

To cancel it, just go in your account profile to "settings" → "subscription" → "Cancel subscription". At least 24h before the renewal of the new cycle.

If a subscription is not renewed, you will lose access to your list of certificates and you will not be able to download them, but the records are not deleted and are always saved in your user account. To access your account again and manage your list of certificates, you will have to renew your subscription.

items.q: How long does the registration of my piece last?
items.a: Blockchain registers are permanent, and the duration of authorship rights protection is subject to the legislation of each country.

items.q: How to reduce the size of my file to be able to upload it?
items.a:
We only accept files with a weight of less than 30MB. Therefore, in case your file is larger, you will have to compress it.

We remind you that for the registration of authorship rights the important thing is the content and not its audiovisual quality, so there is no problem if the content is inferior when compressed.

items.q: How would a creation be registered when it belongs to two or more authors?
items.a:
The best way to register the co-authorship or multiple-ownership of a creation with Musicdibs is by making two records in the blockchain: one of the song (lyrics, sound recording…) and one with all the information of the authors (name and document of identity of each co-author), any information on the distribution of each co-author's rights and the information of the song registration made previously (transaction identifier, file's digital trace and blockchain network). Additionally, you must select the option "I want this certification to be public" in both registers.

By doing it in this way you can verify the registration of both the song and the co-authorship document and the timestamp of the records guarantees its legal validity.

items.q: If I don't renew my subscription, will I lose my records?
items.a:
Registrations (certificates) are permanent and never expire, but if a subscription is not renewed, you will lose access to the platform and will not be able to manage and download your list of certificates. To access your account again and manage your list of certificates, you will need to renew your subscription.

At Musicdibs we recommend that you KEEP your subscription as much as possible, as the price is currently very attractive thanks to the effort we have made to offer a low and affordable price for everyone. In the future we plan to add new features to the subscriptions. If you keep your current subscription now you are sure to keep your current price as well.

items.q: Once registered, how can I prove the authorship of my work to a third party?
items.a:
The registration of the file generates a hash and a time stamp, where the identification data that automatically link the author with his creation is encrypted. In the event of a legal dispute, anyone can validate said code and verify that you are the original author.

Once certified, it is important not to make any changes to the original file, so as not to modify its digital trace.

items.q: What are valid identity documents to verify my identity?
items.a:
For your records to have legal validity, it is necessary to verify your identity with an official identification document valid in your country that contains a photo of you and your personal information, or your passport. In Spain and all other countries of the European Union you can use your National Identification Card or passport.

If your country is not on the accepted list or you have any questions, please contact us.

items.q: What file types can you register?
items.a:
You can register all kinds of files, the format is irrelevant. They can be either finished works or partial ones (in the process of creation). In the latter case, you will have to make successive records of each of the milestones you achieve: chapters, partial assemblies, sketches, etc. We will create a record of each delivery, which will also provide you with traceability in your creative process.

Just remember that the maximum allowed file size is 30Mb. If your work is larger, you will have to compress it.

items.q: What happens if one day Musicdibs "disappears"? Would certificates lose its validity?
items.a: Nothing would happen to your registered works thanks to the decentralized and public technology we use, formed by a network with thousands of nodes in the cloud that would have to disappear completely (which is something completely impossible).

items.q: What happens if someone registers my song in another registry? Can I use my Musicdibs certificate to claim my authorship?
items.a:
You should know that intellectual property is not like industrial property. In the European Union it is not mandatory to carry out an administrative act to be considered the author of a piece and it is enough to demonstrate its previous creation. The intellectual property of a literary, artistic or scientific work corresponds to the author by the sole fact of its creation.

If someone copies a song previously registered on the Blockchain, you can provide your registration as valid proof in a plagiarism complaint, since a receipt is generated in every Musicdibs registry that contains all the necessary information, both to identify the work in your name and to prove the registration with its time stamp. With the Musicdibs certificate you will be able to demonstrate that you were its creator and that therefore have the right of ownership over it.

items.q: What happens to my certifications if I unsubscribe from the service?
items.a:
Musicdibs ONLY uses robust public and decentralized blockchains (e.g. Ethereum, Polygon and Solana) that are not dependent on iCommunity Labs and are supported by a large community of users. This ensures that certifications made through Musicdibs will always be accessible and persist, even if the user terminates or iCommunity Labs disappears in the future. This makes the certifications issued by Musicdibs digital evidence fully available for audits or technical expertise and with evidentiary effects in dispute proceedings or similar.

However, you must remember that to check the certification of a document you must be in possession of the original document.

items.q: What type of works and files can I register?
items.a:
With Musicdibs you can register the authorship rights of any creative and artistic work:

– Music: songs, lyrics, sheet music, sound recordings.
– Audiovisual: scripts, treatments, ideas/synopsis, video pieces, storyboards.
– Literary work: manuscripts and drafts, titles and names, translations, adaptations and derivatives.

And you can register all kinds of files, both finished works in any digital audio or video format (mp3, WAV, AIFF, WMA, mp4, etc.) and text files (PDF, DOC) if they are scores, lyrics or scripts. Just remember that the maximum allowed file size is 30Mb.

items.q: How do I find my Spotify Artist ID?
items.a:
The Spotify Artist ID is a unique identifier that Spotify assigns to each artist profile. You will need it to correctly link your releases to your profile when distributing your music.

Steps to find it:

1. Open Spotify (in the app or in your browser at open.spotify.com).
2. Search for your artist name and open your artist profile (not a song or album).
3. Click the three dots (•••) next to your name and select "Share" → "Copy link to artist".
4. Paste the link; it will look like this: https://open.spotify.com/artist/3TVXtAsR1Inumwj472S9r4
5. Your Spotify Artist ID is the string of characters after /artist/. In the example: 3TVXtAsR1Inumwj472S9r4.

Important: make sure you copy the artist profile URL, not a song or album URL. Otherwise you will not get the correct ID.

Read the full guide on our blog: /news/how-to-get-spotify-artist-id

This is your dashboard. From here you have an overview and can access all musician tools.

Let us quickly show you how it works.

• Registered works
• Pending registrations
• Available credits

You can buy individual credits or use a subscription to reduce the cost per registration.

voiceToolsTour.step1Content:
Clone your voice, sing in 29 languages and create professional vocal versions of any lyrics.

Features:
• Clone your voice in seconds
• Generate vocal tracks with your cloned voice
• Sing lyrics you write

Let us show you how it works step by step.
voiceToolsTour.step2Content:
To use your own voice, you need to clone it first.

Audio requirements:
✓ At least 30 seconds of recording
✓ Your voice only (no background music)
✓ Clear and natural speech
✓ MP3, WAV or M4A (max. 25 MB)

Tip: Record in a quiet place and speak naturally, as if you were telling a story.
voiceToolsTour.step3Content:
Once your voice is cloned, it will appear in this list.

You can:
• View all your cloned voices
• Listen to previews of each voice
• Delete voices you don't use
• Select a voice to use in "Sing"

Cloning takes ~2-3 minutes. You'll be notified when it's ready.
voiceToolsTour.step4Content:
With your cloned voice, you can generate complete songs:

1️⃣ Select a cloned voice
2️⃣ Write or paste the lyrics
3️⃣ Choose musical genre and mood
4️⃣ Generate your vocal track

The AI will sing your lyrics using your voice with professional quality.
voiceToolsTour.step5Content:
You don't need to write the lyrics yourself.

Click "Free generation" to:
• Describe the song theme
• Select genre and mood
• Generate complete lyrics with AI
• Use the generated lyrics directly

The lyrics are automatically loaded into the text field.
voiceToolsTour.step6Content:
Adjust how your song sounds:

🎵 Central theme
Love, Heartbreak, Party, Overcoming, etc.

🎸 Musical genre
Pop, Rock, Reggaeton, Hip-Hop, and more

🎭 Mood / Tone
Happy, Melancholic, Epic, Energetic, etc.

These parameters define the style of the generated vocal track.

promoMaterialTour.step1Content:
Generate covers, creatives, videos and posters to promote your music with AI.

Available tools:
• Covers for Spotify/Apple Music
• Creatives for Instagram and YouTube
• Videos for social media
• Posters for events and concerts

All content is generated in seconds with professional quality.
promoMaterialTour.step2Content:
Generate professional covers optimized for:
✓ Spotify
✓ YouTube Music
✓ Apple Music
✓ Amazon Music

4 creation modes:
• No image (AI generates everything)
• Artist photo only
• Reference cover
• Photomontage (combines photo + inspiration)

Cost: 2 credits per cover
promoMaterialTour.step3Content:
Generate content optimized for each platform:

📱 Instagram
• Feed Post (1:1) → image + copy + hashtags
• Story (9:16) → image + copy + hashtags

🎬 YouTube
• Thumbnail (16:9) → eye-catching image with text

AI generates both the image and accompanying text automatically.

Cost: 1 credit per creative
promoMaterialTour.step4Content:
📸 Feed Post (square 1:1)
For Instagram's main feed
Ideal for: single announcements, covers, artistic photos

📱 Story (vertical 9:16)
For Instagram stories
Ideal for: teasers, behind the scenes, temporary announcements

Both include:
✓ Optimized image
✓ Custom copy
✓ Relevant hashtags
promoMaterialTour.step5Content:
Generate short videos (3-5 seconds) optimized for:
• TikTok
• Instagram Reels
• YouTube Shorts

Two ways to create:
1️⃣ Text → Video (describe the concept)
2️⃣ Image → Video (animate a cover or photo)

Perfect for promoting releases dynamically.

Cost: 10 credits per video
promoMaterialTour.step6Content:
Create professional posters for:

🎪 Events and concerts
• Flyer (A5) → pocket size
• Poster (A4) → standard size
• Large Poster (A3) → visual impact

🌐 Social media
• Facebook Event Cover (1920x1080)
• Twitter/X Header (1500x500)

Includes: date, venue, time, logo and artist photo.

Cost: 1 credit per poster
promoMaterialTour.step7Content:
In all sections you can upload files in two ways:

🖱️ Click to select
Click on the upload area and select the file

📂 Drag and drop
Drag the image/photo directly from your computer

Accepted formats:
• Images: JPG, PNG, WEBP (max. 10MB)
• Audio: MP3, WAV (videos only)
promoMaterialTour.step8Content:
Once content is generated:

✓ On-screen preview
✓ Direct download button
✓ Auto-copy text (copy/hashtags)
✓ Files optimized for each platform

All content is saved in your account and can be downloaded anytime.

💡 Tip: Generate multiple versions for A/B testing on social media.
